name: Absurd News
blurb: Today's real headlines, reported accurately and then punctured, as a two-anchor broadcast.
detail: Reads a live news feed, picks three stories that can carry irony without anyone getting hurt, reads the full articles, writes a sixty-second bulletin for Dale and Priya, and films it at the newsdesk. The facts are real and land first; the joke comes after.
reworkExamples: Use US, tech and Seattle news instead of the BBC feed
Add a heartwarming story from anywhere in the world
Make the bulletin thirty seconds instead of sixty
